observations:
ENTRY RULE (fits all 9 orig trades): short entry = min(impulse body mid, lowest prior low of the last ~3-4 bars that the impulse closed below); long entry = max(impulse body mid, highest prior high of last ~3-4 bars that the impulse closed above) - i.e. retest of the level the impulse broke, capped at body mid. Examples: Wed 13:55 short 4154.6=13:45 low (mid 4154.7); Thu 05:40 short 4132.7=05:30 low (mid 4133.5); Thu 09:40 long 4163.7=09:20 high (mid 4162.45, lookback must reach 3 bars back). Others = body mid.
ONE TRADE AT A TIME: neither indicator opens a new trade while one is live; most divergences cascade from that. Thu: mine 04:35 long (open to 06:20) blocked the orig 05:40 short; mine 09:10 long (open to 10:55) blocked the orig 09:40 long.
FILLS CAP 5/day decides late trades: Wed mine had 5 fills by 11:35 (05:00,05:45,06:05,07:55,11:35) so missed orig 13:55 short; Thu orig had 5 fills by 11:40 so skipped the 13:30 impulse that mine (4 fills) took at 13:40. Fix the early-session divergences and the cap behaviour follows.
SKIPPED IMPULSES by orig (mine traded): Wed 04:55 (mine long 05:00, ~85 min after 03:30 open), Wed 05:40 (O4191.1 C4197.1 crossing VWAP up, mine fill 05:45), Wed 06:00 (orig kept the earlier 05:55 short level 4189.25 instead of re-arming to 06:00 mid 4185.95 - pending order not replaced by a newer same-direction impulse), Thu 04:30 (O4131.2 C4134.7 body 3.5 crossing VWAP up, 60 min after open; orig instead armed on 04:45 body 1.4 candle closing above VWAP), Thu 09:05 (O4158.3 C4161.6 body 3.3, ~14 above VWAP, 65 min after orig TP4 at 08:00; orig took 09:35 body 2.9 instead).
